subject: Renewal kickoff — Acme capacity alignment & QBR scheduling
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Jones <sarah.jones@acmetech.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-18T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Renewal kickoff — Acme capacity alignment & QBR scheduling

Hi Sarah —

Thanks again for partnering with Redwood this year. As we approach ACME's renewal we want to kick off coordination so there are no surprises on capacity, terms, or timing. High level asks below; please flag anything I missed.

Proposed timeline
- Today (11/18): kickoff and draft MAP attached (see attached PDF).
- 11/19–11/26: internal approvals + procurement pricing review.
- 12/01: finalize committed capacity & order.
- Week of 12/06: QBR to review usage, new SLAs, and rollout plan.

Key discussion items
- Committed capacity increase: ACME has signaled a ~35% uptick in text generation tokens for H1; we want to confirm target concurrency and monthly commit.
- Term & pricing: options for 12‑ or 24‑month terms and tiered per‑token discounts.
- Procurement needs: contract redlines, invoicing cadence, and any SOC/compliance docs required.

Immediate asks
1) Can you confirm the internal stakeholders we should include from ACME (procurement, cloud/infra, legal)?
2) Is your budget/renewal window between Dec 1–15 still accurate?
3) Are you available for a QBR during week of Dec 6–10? We have availability Dec 8 or Dec 9 in the morning PT.

I've attached a short draft mutual action plan to start the loop ("2026-11-18-Acme-MAP-draft.pdf"). If it's helpful I can also surface two pricing options (12m vs 24m) for procurement on 11/19.

Thanks — look forward to aligning.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
E: evelyn.hart@redwood.com | M: +1 (415) 555-0192
Redwood Inference

Attachment: 2026-11-18-Acme-MAP-draft.pdf (pdf)

From: Sarah Jones <sarah.jones@acmetech.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Li <tom.li@acmetech.com>, procurement@acmetech.com
Date: 2026-11-18T11:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Renewal kickoff — Acme capacity alignment & QBR scheduling

Hi Evelyn —

Thanks for the clear plan and the MAP. Quick answers:
- Please include Tom Li (cloud architecture) and our procurement alias (procurement@acmetech.com) on follow-ups.
- Budget window: correct — procurement needs final PO by Dec 15 to hit our fiscal close.
- QBR: Dec 8 at 10:00 AM PT works for me; Tom says he can make it.

A couple things to flag on our side:
- We need an estimate of peak concurrent requests and a bandwidth plan in your capacity proposal; our infra team will validate for autoscaling.
- Pricing: if you can provide a not-to-exceed number for our procurement team that’s ideal; they prefer to see two committed-term scenarios.

Please loop in legal if you anticipate redlines beyond standard SLAs. Looking forward to the QBR draft agenda.

Best,
Sarah Jones
Director of AI Platforms | Acme Technology
sarah.jones@acmetech.com

Vanessa: can you prepare two procurement-ready pricing options (12m/24m) with NTE numbers and include standard SLR/SLA language? Procurement wants a not-to-exceed figure. Attachments: pricing spreadsheet would be great by COB 11/19.

Marcus: can you draft a short capacity plan that calls out expected peak concurrency, KV cache sizing recommendations, and the suggested dedicated pool vs. burst strategy for the 35% uptick? ACME’s infra will validate; aim for a 1‑page summary.

I'll confirm the QBR agenda and send a calendar invite once we have pricing + capacity outlines. HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/ACME-78

Evelyn
